new: 手动导入时，与素材库中完全相同的图片会自动跳过，并提示「已在素材库中」。缩放、重新压缩或更换格式后的相似图片照常导入，导入完成后可逐张选择保留或删除，新图更清晰时可替换原图。
导入到分组或堆叠时，若图片已在素材库的其他位置，可选择保留原位置或移过来。
在「待整理」中可以把素材、整个堆叠或多选的素材标为已整理，标记后离开待整理，在即梦网站删除作品时也不会移动它们。
improved: 放大查看图片，或在高分辨率屏幕上查看大图时，查看器会自动换用原图显示，细节更清晰。
软件内更新改为使用系统网络设置，开启系统代理的电脑也能检查和下载更新。
安装更新前会检查磁盘空间；Windows 版还会检查 AI 助手是否正在通过 MCP 使用 GravityPort，并提示先退出。
macOS 版安装更新时占用的临时磁盘空间减少约一半。
导入大量图片时，每批导入完成后画廊即显示新图片，并按实际比例排列；新导入的图片优先生成缩略图。向下浏览时导入不改变当前位置，可在提示中点击「查看」回到新图片。
「待整理」现在显示所有尚未整理的素材，自动生成的堆叠不再视为已整理，并按堆叠显示为一张卡片。
AI 助手保存素材库中已有的图片时，直接返回已有的那张，不再重复保存。
同一个网页视频收到更清晰的版本时，会替换原视频，不再多出一份。
自动生成的堆叠改为以最新收录的图片作为封面；在收藏、待整理、分组等筛选视图中，堆叠卡片显示其中符合条件的图片。手动建立或调整过顺序的堆叠保持原有顺序。
加强了 GravityPort 与本机后台服务之间的身份校验：连接前先确认服务身份，访问凭据不再出现在页面地址中。
GravityPort 未打开时，浏览器扩展可暂存更多作品：不再限制 256 张，只按 512MB 总容量计算，视频也会先保存下来。空间快满或有作品只保存了网址时，会在「设置 → 连接」中提示。即梦的删除同步在 GravityPort 关闭期间也会排队，打开后补发。（浏览器扩展 0.15.44）
加强了本机后台服务的访问保护：查看素材、原图、视频和提示词也需要 GravityPort 的访问凭据；服务状态信息不再包含素材库所在位置；网页收录的单次请求大小和同时接收的总量设了上限，过大的视频会自动改用其他方式上传。
诊断日志会遮蔽更多个人信息，包括各种写法的文件路径和文件名、分组和会话名称、手机号、身份证号和本机名称；界面报错只记录一条摘要，不含内容。桌面版另在本机保存一份仅含警告和错误的日志，最多约 6MB，循环覆盖，不会上传。
没有生成记录的版本家族（例如由 AI 助手创建的版本）也可以在「版本树」中点击「查看」，打开版本历史和版本对比。
fixed: 修复了同一张图片再次收录时可能覆盖原图或清空提示词的问题。现仅在新图更清晰时替换，被替换的旧图移入回收站。
修复了在即梦网站删除作品后，已精选、归档、手动堆叠或修改过提示词的素材，以及复制出的副本和版本仍被移入回收站的问题。因站内删除而移入回收站的素材，会在详情中注明原因。
修复了素材库的数据库文件丢失或素材库被移动后，可能新建空素材库继续收录，或 AI 助手仍写入原位置的问题。现会停止并提示素材库所在位置。
修复了在 GravityPort 中或通过 AI 助手修改的提示词和名称，会在重启或再次收录后被改回的问题。
修复了 GravityPort 未打开时，浏览器扩展在网页上反复重发和重新下载同一张图片的问题。现由扩展暂存，GravityPort 打开后自动补收。（浏览器扩展 0.15.44）
修复了 Midjourney 连续生成多个作品时，每隔几个作品会漏收一个的问题。（浏览器扩展 0.15.44）
修复了 GravityPort 启动较慢时（如在 Windows 上），浏览器扩展无法自动配对的问题。（浏览器扩展 0.15.44）
修复了更新安装失败时没有提示、反复显示「重启更新」的问题。现会说明原因；同一版本两次未装上时，引导前往官网下载。
修复了在「设置 → 关于」中下载更新出错后，按钮一直停在「正在下载」的问题。系统已弹出说明时，不再另外提示更新失败。
修复了 Grok 收到与其他来源相同的图片时，会改掉原有提示词的问题。
修复了删除 Midjourney 预览图后，收到同一作品的原图时又被收录的问题。
修复了素材详情中参考图缩略图被压成正方形的问题。现按原图比例完整显示。
修复了在 macOS 上将素材拖到其他应用时，松手瞬间图片突然放大的问题。
修复了在堆叠中选中多张素材后拖到其他应用（如访达、Photoshop）时只带出一张的问题。现在会带出全部选中的素材；在堆叠内调整顺序时，选中的素材也会整组移动。
修复了英文界面中「即梦」分组名、来源标签和参考图悬停提示仍显示中文的问题。
修复了原图文件丢失时查看器一片空白的问题。现会提示「原图找不到了」，并可打开素材位置。
修复了版本树、版本和参考图加载失败时，与「暂无」显示相同的问题。现会显示「加载失败」。
other: 为软件内更新增加备用签名钥匙。
侧栏的 Pinterest 入口改为标注「即将上线」，正式开放前不显示画板数量。

new: Manual imports now skip files identical to an image already in the library. Resized, recompressed or converted copies are still imported, then listed for you to keep or delete, or to replace the original when the new copy is sharper.
When importing into a group or stack, images already elsewhere in the library can stay where they are or move in.
In Unsorted, you can now mark assets, whole stacks or a selection as sorted. They leave Unsorted, and deleting the work on the Jimeng website no longer moves them.
improved: The viewer now switches to the original image when you zoom in, or when large images are shown on high-resolution screens, for sharper detail.
In-app updates now use the system network settings, so computers that go through a system proxy can check for and download updates.
Updates now check free disk space before installing. On Windows, GravityPort also checks whether an AI assistant is using it through MCP and asks you to quit the assistant first.
Installing an update on macOS now needs about half as much temporary disk space.

Large imports now show new images in the gallery as each batch finishes, at their real proportions, and thumbnails are made for the newest images first. Importing no longer moves you while you browse further down; select View in the notice to jump to the new images.
Unsorted now shows every asset you have not sorted yet. Automatic stacks no longer count as sorted, and each appears as one card.
When an AI assistant saves an image that is already in the library, GravityPort returns the existing image instead of saving another copy.
When a sharper version of the same web video arrives, it replaces the original instead of adding another copy.

Automatic stacks now use the most recently captured image as their cover. In filtered views such as Favorites, Unsorted and groups, a stack card shows the image that matches. Stacks you created or reordered keep your order.
Strengthened identity checks between GravityPort and its local background service: the app confirms the service before connecting, and the access credential no longer appears in the page address.

While GravityPort is closed, the browser extension now keeps captures up to 512 MB with no 256-item limit, videos included. Settings → Connect warns when space runs low or a capture kept only its URL. Jimeng deletions also queue until GravityPort opens. (Browser extension 0.15.44)

Strengthened protection of the local background service: viewing assets, originals and prompts now also requires GravityPort's credential, service status no longer reveals the library location, and web captures are size-limited, with large videos switching upload method automatically.

Diagnostic logs now mask more personal details: file paths and names in any form, group and conversation names, phone and ID numbers, and the computer name. Interface errors are kept as a summary only. The desktop app also keeps a local warnings-and-errors log, up to about 6 MB, never uploaded.
Version families without generation records, such as versions created by an AI assistant, can now also open Version History and the version compare from View in the Version Tree.
fixed: Fixed an issue where capturing the same image again could overwrite the original or clear its prompt. The image is now replaced only by a sharper version, and the previous one moves to the Trash.

Fixed an issue where deleting a work on the Jimeng website could still move curated, archived, manually stacked or prompt-edited assets, as well as duplicates and versions, to the Trash. Assets moved for this reason now show it in the details panel.

Fixed an issue where a library whose database file was lost, or that had been moved, could be replaced by a new empty library that kept capturing, or AI assistants could keep writing to the old location. GravityPort now stops and shows where the library is.
Fixed an issue where prompts and names edited in GravityPort or through an AI assistant could be reverted after a restart or when the image was captured again.

Fixed an issue where the browser extension kept resending and re-downloading the same image while GravityPort was closed. The extension now holds it and delivers it once GravityPort opens. (Browser extension 0.15.44)
Fixed an issue where Midjourney could skip one work every few works when several were generated in a row. (Browser extension 0.15.44)
Fixed an issue where the browser extension could not pair automatically when GravityPort started slowly, such as on Windows. (Browser extension 0.15.44)

Fixed an issue where a failed update install showed no message and kept offering Restart to Update. GravityPort now shows the reason, and after two failed installs of the same version it points to the website download.
Fixed an issue where the update button in Settings → About stayed on Downloading after a download error. When a system dialog already explains the problem, no separate update-failed message appears.
Fixed an issue where Grok could change the prompt of an image first captured from another source.
Fixed an issue where a deleted Midjourney preview could be captured again when the full-size image of the same work arrived.
Fixed an issue where reference image thumbnails in the details panel were squeezed into squares. They now keep their original proportions.
Fixed an issue on macOS where an image suddenly enlarged at the moment it was dropped into another app.

Fixed an issue where dragging several selected assets out of a stack into another app, such as Finder or Photoshop, carried only one. All selected assets now go along, and reordering inside a stack moves the selection as one group.
Fixed the Jimeng group name, source tag and reference image tooltips still showing Chinese in the English interface.
Fixed the viewer staying blank when an original file is missing. It now says the original file was not found and offers to open the asset location.
Fixed the Version Tree, versions and reference images looking empty when they failed to load. They now show Failed to load.
other: Added a backup signing key for in-app updates.
The Pinterest entry in the sidebar now reads Coming soon and shows no board count until Pinterest opens to everyone.

new: 在即梦网站中删除作品后，GravityPort 中对应的素材将同步移入回收站；已收藏、评分、分组或添加标签的素材不受影响，可在设置中关闭。（浏览器扩展 0.15.43）
improved: 参考图与素材库中已有的图片完全相同时，仅占用一份磁盘空间。
侧栏的更新提醒改为「用户中心」上方的单行提示。
fixed: 修复了即梦带参考图生成的图片和视频收录后缺少参考图的问题。（浏览器扩展 0.15.41）
修复了 Google AI Studio 带参考图生成的图片收录后缺少参考图的问题。（浏览器扩展 0.15.43）
修复了预览视频时播放控件无法操作、缩放栏遮挡画面的问题。
修复了详情面板中属性标签排列拥挤的问题。
修复了刚收录的参考图可能被误清理的问题。
修复了手动导入和 Cowart 素材在详情中不显示文件大小的问题。

new: Deleting a work on the Jimeng website now moves the matching GravityPort asset to the Trash. Assets that are favorited, rated, grouped or tagged are left untouched. This can be turned off in Settings. (Browser extension 0.15.43)
improved: Reference images identical to an image already in the library now take up disk space only once.
The sidebar update reminder is now a single line above the user center.
fixed: Fixed an issue where Jimeng images and videos generated from reference images were captured without their references. (Browser extension 0.15.41)
Fixed an issue where Google AI Studio images generated from reference images were captured without their references. (Browser extension 0.15.43)
Fixed an issue where video playback controls could not be used in the viewer and the zoom bar covered the video.
Fixed an issue where property tags in the details panel were crowded together.
Fixed an issue where newly captured reference images could be cleaned up by mistake.
Fixed an issue where manually imported and Cowart assets showed no file size in the details panel.

new: 支持粘贴导入：按 ⌘V（Windows 为 Ctrl+V），或在空白处右键选择「粘贴」，即可将剪贴板中的图片、视频和截图导入素材库。在分组或堆叠内粘贴，素材将直接归入其中。
Codex、Grok 收录的素材现可保留用户指令。已有的 Codex 素材会在启动后自动补全。
即梦素材按对话窗口自动分组。
improved: 视频按原始比例显示，并自动生成封面，跳过片头黑场。
详情面板新增视频时长。
fixed: 修复了即梦新生成的图片无法收录的问题，现收录原图。（浏览器扩展 0.15.40）
other: 许可协议更新：现可用于工作及客户项目。

new: Paste to import: press ⌘V (Ctrl+V on Windows) or right-click an empty area and choose Paste to add copied images, videos and screenshots to your library. Pasting inside a group or stack adds them there.
Codex and Grok captures now keep the user instruction. Existing Codex assets are filled in after launch.
Jimeng captures are grouped automatically by conversation window.
improved: Videos display at their original aspect ratio with an automatic poster that skips black opening frames.
The details panel now shows video duration.
fixed: Fixed an issue where new Jimeng generations were not captured. Full-resolution originals are now saved. (Browser extension 0.15.40)
other: License update: GravityPort can now be used for work and client projects.

zh: App 开着时也会自动检查更新并在后台下载，下好后侧栏会出现常驻的「重启并更新」按钮，点一下就完成更新。
浏览器扩展 0.15.39：即梦和 Midjourney 的图和视频也能自动收进素材库了，提示词、来源一起带上；Midjourney 优先收原图，历史旧图不会被自动灌进来，想收旧图右键保存即可。
en: The app now checks for updates while it runs and downloads them in the background; when one is ready, a persistent Restart to update button appears in the sidebar.
Extension 0.15.39 archives generated images and videos from Jimeng and Midjourney with prompts and provenance. Old history is never auto-imported; right-click saves any item.

zh: 版本树里可以挑任意两轮对话并排对比：两边的图、你的指令和提示词放在一起，有变化的地方会标出来。
把图拖进画廊或粘贴进来时，如果正开着某个分组，图会直接进这个分组。
「设置 → 连接」新增浏览器扩展卡片：看扩展连上没有、是哪个版本、还有几张图等着重试，一键重试。
浏览器扩展 0.15.38：GravityPort 没开时也会把图片本身存下来，打开 App 后照常入库，不会因为网址过期丢图。到官网下载新版，解压覆盖原文件夹，在 chrome://extensions 点刷新。
Windows 版改成安装程序：下载后双击就能装好，开始菜单和桌面会出现 GravityPort，不用再解压；已经在用的不用重装。
App 内更新更稳：新版第一次启动有 2 分钟准备时间；新版一旦升级了素材库，就不会再退回打不开它的旧版。
内置的 Electron 升到 43.8.3，带上近三个月的 Chromium 安全修复。
en: Compare any two conversation rounds side by side in the version tree: both images, your instruction and the prompt, with changes marked.
Dropping or pasting images into the gallery while a group is open now adds them to that group.
Settings → Connections has a new Browser extension card: whether it is connected, which version it runs, how many captures wait to retry, and a Retry button.
Extension 0.15.38 keeps the image itself while GravityPort is closed, so captures arrive when you open it. Get it from the website, unzip over the old folder, reload it in chrome://extensions.
Windows now comes as an installer: double-click it and GravityPort appears in the Start menu and on the desktop, no unzipping. If you already use GravityPort, nothing changes.
Safer in-app updates: the new version gets two minutes to start, and once it has upgraded your library the update is never rolled back to a version that cannot open it.
The built-in Electron is now 43.8.3, with the last three months of Chromium security fixes.

zh: GravityPort 自带 MCP 服务：在「设置 → 连接」的「AI 助手（MCP）」卡片复制配置，粘进 Claude Desktop、Claude Code 或 Codex，AI 助手就能搜索、查看素材库，也能把新图加进来，不用另装 Node.js。挪过素材库后，重启 AI 助手就会跟上。
检查更新、下载更新包、发送反馈都改走 gravityport.azhuilab.com。
关闭匿名统计等高级开关改用 GRAVITYPORT_ 开头的环境变量名，例如 GRAVITYPORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1；以前设过的照样生效。
en: GravityPort now ships its own MCP server: paste a config from Settings → Connections into Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or Codex, and the assistant can search, read, and add to your library.
Update checks, update downloads, and feedback now go to gravityport.azhuilab.com.
Advanced switches such as turning off anonymous usage now use GRAVITYPORT_ environment variable names, for example GRAVITYPORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1; values you set before keep working.

zh: 修复：删除图片或合并堆叠后，详情栏会自动落到画廊第一张；这张软件自己选中的卡片不再被 ⌘ 点选或 Shift 框选一起带进选区，也不会被单按 Delete 删掉。亲手点它一下就恢复正常选中。
堆叠按里面最新的一张图排序：堆叠收进新图会往前排，把那张图移到回收站后又退回原处。已有的堆叠在第一次打开素材库时重新排一次。
侧栏重新显示 Pinterest 入口（标着「暂未开放」），「设置 → 连接」也放回来了；Pinterest 接口还在试用额度，正式批准前浏览会受限。
en: Fixed: the card the Inspector falls back to after a delete or stack merge no longer joins a ⌘-click or Shift-marquee selection or answers Delete; click it once to select it normally.
Stacks now sort by their newest image: a stack moves up when it gains a new image and back when that image goes to the Trash. Existing stacks are re-sorted the first time the library opens.
The Pinterest entry is back in the sidebar (marked Not yet available), along with Settings → Connections; Pinterest access is still on the trial tier, so browsing stays limited until it is approved.

zh: MOSA 更名为 GravityPort：应用、浏览器扩展和命令行都换了新名字，素材库、设置和扩展配对原样保留。
macOS 上更新后应用名变为 GravityPort.app，旧的 MOSA.app 会被移到废纸篓。
en: MOSA is now GravityPort: the app, browser extension, and command line use the new name, while your library, settings, and extension pairing stay exactly where they were.
On macOS the app is renamed to GravityPort.app after the update, and the old MOSA.app is moved to the Trash.

zh: MOSA 即将更名为 GravityPort：这是更名前的过渡版本，再更新一次就会变成 GravityPort。素材库、设置和扩展配对原样保留。
全新界面：画廊、检视器和设置整体重做，层级更清楚。
拖拽整理：把卡片拖到侧栏分组归类，拖到另一张卡上合成堆叠，堆叠里可以拖动排序，也能直接拖出应用；拖错了可以撤销。
回收站：删除后可以马上撤销；回收站里的素材保留 90 天并显示剩余天数，可以恢复、永久删除或一键清空。
版本树按 ChatGPT 对话的轮次分组，展开就能看到每一轮生成的缩略图。
设置里新增「反馈」：直接把问题或建议发给我们，可以选择附上已脱敏的诊断日志，发送前能看到全文。
设置 →「关于」里能看到这个版本更新了什么；有新版本时，会先列出新版本的更新内容。
从大图、堆叠或其他视图返回画廊时，会回到原来的位置；长列表多了「回到顶部」按钮。
框选更顺手：可以从空白处开始框选，按住 Shift 加选，拖到窗口边缘会自动滚动；⌘A 和多选拖动都包括堆叠。
画廊里的横图排得更整齐，不再留下大块空白。
检视器头部显示类型、来源和日期；标签改成纯文字；比例直接显示 16:9、9:16 这样的名字。
搜索只匹配你看得见的内容，比如文件名、提示词、标签和分组，结果更准。
macOS 上可以按住窗口顶部拖动窗口。
修复：把素材库里的图拖出去再拖回来，不会再重复导入一份。
查看大图时可以全屏，收起侧栏和详情，只留图片。
修复：视频卡片不再显示破图，画廊和详情里显示视频画面，右上角有播放标记。
修复：少数图片缩略图比例不对、点开大图是空白。
在 ChatGPT 桌面应用里聊天生成的图片，现在也能通过网页采集扩展自动收录（需开启自动采集）。
修复：新版 Codex 生成的图片重新记录 Codex 实际使用的提示词，不再误用你的聊天消息。
侧栏「我的分组」的右键菜单换成和素材右键菜单一样的样式：分组颜色收进二级菜单，删除单独放在最下面。
画廊支持键盘浏览：方向键移到相邻卡片，回车打开；⌘F 或 / 跳到搜索框，菜单里的「查找」也能用了。
按 Delete 删除时也遵守「不再提醒」，不再每次弹确认。
浏览器扩展关掉自动入库后，不再自己上报 ChatGPT 对话标题。
修复：同时选中单图和堆叠后，在堆叠卡片上右键删除，现在会把整个选区移到回收站，不再只删堆叠；选区里有堆叠时，即使勾了「不再提醒」也会先确认。
把一个堆叠拖到另一个堆叠上就能合并；拖到普通图片上会和它合成新堆叠。合并后可以撤销。
修复：在堆叠里把图片移到回收站后，画廊偶尔会跳回上方，现在会停在原来的位置。
多选后右键可以复制图片和路径；堆叠右键可以复制全部图片和全部路径。多张图片以文件形式复制，能直接粘贴到访达、聊天软件或网页。
en: MOSA is becoming GravityPort: one more update makes the switch. Your library, settings, and extension pairing stay exactly as they are.
A new interface: the gallery, Inspector, and Settings are redesigned with a clearer layout.
Drag to organize: drop cards on a sidebar group or another card to stack them, reorder inside a stack, or drag them out of the app; undo any mistake.
Trash: undo a deletion right away; items stay 90 days with the days left shown, and can be restored, deleted forever, or cleared at once.
The version tree groups ChatGPT images by conversation round, with thumbnails for every round when expanded.
Settings has a new Feedback page, with an optional redacted diagnostic log you can read before sending.
Settings → About lists what changed in this version, and what's coming when an update is available.
Going back to the gallery from the viewer, a stack, or another view returns to where you were; long lists get Back to top.
Smoother marquee selection: start from empty space, Shift to add, auto-scroll at the window edge. ⌘A and multi-card drags include stacks.
Wide images line up more evenly in the gallery instead of leaving large gaps.
The Inspector header shows kind, source, and date; tags are plain text; aspect ratios use familiar names like 16:9 and 9:16.
Search matches only what you can see, such as file names, prompts, tags, and groups, so results are more accurate.
On macOS, drag the top of the window to move it.
Fixed: dragging a library image out and back in no longer imports a duplicate.
Fullscreen in the image viewer: the sidebar and details collapse, leaving only the picture.
Fixed: video cards no longer show a broken image; they show a video frame with a play badge.
Fixed: a few images showed a wrong thumbnail ratio or a blank large view.
Images made in ChatGPT desktop-app chats are now captured too, through the Web Capture extension with auto capture on.
Fixed: images from newer Codex versions record the prompt Codex actually used again, instead of your chat message.
The My groups right-click menu now matches the asset menu: colors in a submenu, Delete at the bottom.
Keyboard browsing: arrow keys move between cards, Enter opens, ⌘F or / jumps to search.
Pressing Delete now honours "Don’t ask again" instead of always asking for confirmation.
With auto capture off, the browser extension no longer reports ChatGPT conversation titles on its own.
Fixed: right-clicking a selected stack card now trashes the whole selection, and a selection with a stack always asks first.
Drag a stack onto another stack to merge them; drop it on a single image to stack them together. Merges can be undone.
Fixed: moving an image to the trash inside a stack could make the gallery jump back up; it now stays where you were.
Right-click a multi-selection or a stack to copy its images or paths. Several images copy as files, ready to paste into Finder, chat apps, or web pages.

zh: 修复 Windows 更新助手在成功完成后未显式退出的问题，提升更新流程稳定性。
en: Fix the Windows update helper to exit explicitly after a successful update, improving update reliability.
